sources.use: Adapt stream setup, real codec send/receive, packet rescaling/interleaving, encoder EOF drain and trailer. No synthetic generator is part of production. Retain full MIT notice.
Adapt custom AVIO opaque state and current buffer/context cleanup to an already owned write/seek descriptor. Retain full MIT notice.
Reuse the existing software_codec_probe real decoder/drain test pattern for video content/timing and exact AAC tail-sample checks.

implementationSourcesRead.use: Actual PTS/duration propagation, B-frame drain, option and frame-lifetime contract.
Actual 1024-sample frame, priming and SMALL_LAST_FRAME capability; use real final PCM length.
Actual AVIO callback errors, seek behavior and current-buffer ownership.
Actual max_interleave_delta and packet ownership; not a hard RSS guarantee.
Automatic movie-clock gcd/fallback and AAC priming edit rounding. Official movie_timescale set to audio sample rate fixes observed 15-sample tail loss without a source patch.

localChanges: Single worker, owned empty regular descriptor, extent/time/pixel/PCM budgets, checked I/O and first-error preservation.
No filename reopening, subprocess, device capture, clock inference or automatic silence insertion.
Explicit 100 ns duration, reference-safe AVFrame reuse, opaque SDR swscale conversion, bounded same-rate float-format audio conversion.
Real decode tests require every submitted video frame and exactly every input audio sample, including tails.
